integrity: Four finite shelling orders and an exact standard-library Python verifier are included with reproducible output. All novel finite cases are checked against independently enumerated disconnected triples and the pairwise shelling condition. No independent external audit has been performed.
known_prior_contributions: The non-shellable-range homology, conjectured threshold and proposed sphere counts were previously reported. Novelty is restricted to the missing shellability proofs at four boundary sizes.
limitations: Fixed fourth graph power and ordinary three-cut complexes only. Lower-range rank certificates use mod-two arithmetic; an integral homotopy classification below threshold is not asserted. The four shelling certificates are complete finite permutations, and the upper infinite range invokes a previously published theorem.
title: The sharp three-cut shellability threshold for fourth powers of cycles
